name: Schiltron
description: Inflicting a portion of sustained damage back to its source.
effects: Inflicting a portion of sustained damage back to its source.

source_abilities.name: Schiltron
source_abilities.description:
Counters enemies with unaspected damage every time you suffer physical damage.
Counter Potency: 50
Duration: 15s
Potency is increased to 100 when you are under the effect of Aetheric Mimicry: Tank.
Effect cannot be stacked with Veil of the Whorl or Ice Spikes.
